description_text: An original Space Shark spaceship 3D model. This spacecraft is a whimsical design designed after a sea creature, the shark! The model is not based off any existing intellectual property (unless some gutless megacorp has managed to trademark sharks) .The model is designed for realtime use, with the detail-packed model consisting of only 1,849 faces and 2,097 vertices. The model contains 4096x4096 PNG textures, based on PBR texures, base color, emissive, height, metallic, AO, normal, normal including bump, and roughness maps. AO and bump maps are not required to reproduce the preview renders, as the OpenGL normal map contains the height info in the bump map. UVs mirror across line of symmetry down the center of the model, to further enhance texture resolution.

Overview:
This is a Low-poly, game ready Shipping Container with six versions and six colours (Black, Blue, Green, Grey, Orange, Red)

  - Files named using the Unreal Engine 4 Naming Convention.

  - File uploaded as a packed .7z file.

Geometry:

  - Package includes the six Base Mesh’s and three LOD's each in both .fbx and .obj file formats.

  - Also included is a .uasset file with LOD's, collision, and a generated lightmap (place in your Unreal Engine 4 projects content folder).

  - 3DS Max Dimensions – L6.05m x W2.3m x H2.3m approximate to real world scale

  - Pivot is centred to the base of the model and is set at X:0 Y:0 Z:0

Textures:
PBR Textures are 2048x2048 for the exterior, 2048x2048 for the frame and 2048x2048 for the interior in PNG format with both Metalness and Specular workflow. Also contains two packed Metalness, Roughness, Ambient Occlusion maps.
Included Maps
Metalness

  -   Albedo (A)

  -   Ambient Occlusion (AO)

  - .uasset file does not have materials applied to prevent conflict with your UE4 project pipeline.

A high quality, low-poly forklift model that can be used in any realtime renderer that supports the physically based rendering pipeline.

The asset was created with 3DS Max, textured with Substance Painter.

description_text: An iclone 6.5 or above non human character wyvern , It has bone even in toung with 10 motions 5 for face and 5 for body , but be ware that eyes and eye lashes has no bones because they are props so you can move them by rotation .please check it on youtubehttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fkpkd82gQxEDo you know Greffagon tha iclone character wyvern , it is here in fbx with less price because it dosent have materials nor motion nor eyeballs . Once befor I posted on Facebook if any one would like me to designe a fantasy creature for Reallusion Iclone 6.5 for a price , then some lady commented : what creatures you would designe .I said : may be fairy or Imp .She : No , the Imp and the Fairy are human characters in Iclone , and I need none human character .I said : Ok no problem , do you have a creature in your mind ?She replied : Actually I need a baby dragon with face motion .I Said : ok I will make one for you .When I finished the Shape I imported it in 3D max to add bones but I got some trobles , so I had to wait until I got a higher version of 3D max and I added the bones with Autodesk 3D max 2017 .I gave it some materials and put it for her on other free lancing site , then she said : this is so good at start but I want it looks more cute and I want it on a site that give bill .Then I designed this Gerrafagon by Zbrush and showed her the shape so she said : it is looking cool .When I finished it and shared it here and gave her the link she replied : sorry but i purchased another one because you took so long , but the problem that she showed me what she purchased and it was in OBJ , then how !?How she ask for face motions and purchase OBJ not FBX !?But I shared it here because some one else would like it and purchase it .The dragon you see is a mixed creature between Gerraff and dragon then I called it Gerraffagon the mix bettween the 2 words .It is cartoon funny baby dragon Character can be so useful , with bright colors and pattern on it like Girraff , you can also put other materials or change the colors as you like .May be it would be in a fantasy realm where only dragons lives like The good dinosaur movie .May be you use him as tamed dragon as How to train your dragon movie .May be you use him in a game as main character or boss who know !?In art's realm the only limit is your imagination .

description_text: Do you know Greffagon tha iclone character wyvern , it is here in fbx with less price because it dosent have materials nor motion nor eyeballs . Once befor I posted on Facebook if any one would like me to designe a fantasy creature for Reallusion Iclone 6.5 for a price , then some lady commented : what creatures you would designe .I said : may be fairy or Imp .She : No , the Imp and the Fairy are human characters in Iclone , and I need none human character .I said : Ok no problem , do you have a creature in your mind ?She replied : Actually I need a baby dragon with face motion .I Said : ok I will make one for you .When I finished the Shape I imported it in 3D max to add bones but I got some trobles , so I had to wait until I got a higher version of 3D max and I added the bones with Autodesk 3D max 2017 .I gave it some materials and put it for her on other free lancing site , then she said : this is so good at start but I want it looks more cute and I want it on a site that give bill .Then I designed this Gerrafagon by Zbrush and showed her the shape so she said : it is looking cool .When I finished it and shared it here and gave her the link she replied : sorry but i purchased another one because you took so long , but the problem that she showed me what she purchased and it was in OBJ , then how !?How she ask for face motions and purchase OBJ not FBX !?But I shared it here because some one else would like it and purchase it .The dragon you see is a mixed creature between Gerraff and dragon then I called it Gerraffagon the mix bettween the 2 words .It is cartoon funny baby dragon Character can be so useful , with bright colors and pattern on it like Girraff , you can also put other materials or change the colors as you like .May be it would be in a fantasy realm where only dragons lives like The good dinosaur movie .May be you use him as tamed dragon as How to train your dragon movie .May be you use him in a game as main character or boss who know !?In art's realm the only limit is your imagination .

description_text:
VINTAGE CUSTOM COE DELIVERY VAN
This is a model of a Custom COE Delivery Van, its loosely based on a modified  COE so is not an accurate representation as I didn't work with model sheets but with  photo interpretations of different models, if you are looking for a perfect representation of a COE I'm afraid this model is not suitable for you. 
This Vintage Custom COE Delivery Van is quite versatile and is suitable to be used on retro, old, 50's  up to modern settings.It features a nice detailed interior with rotating doors so you can use it on animation, illustrations and games.It also features wheels that can rotate independently and a cargo area you can fill with boxes and items, also both interior and cargo space are separate models so you can hide them as needed. It uses 3 sets of PBR materials for Albedo + Metallic/Roughness + Normal + Occlusion in PNG format, both exterior and interior use 4096 size textures while the cargo uses 2048 size textures.
=========================Summary info:

Polygon Count: 14044Triangle Count: 26527Verts Count: 14761Number of models: 1 with independent meshes for wheels, doors and interiors.

Model is fully textured, you would need to created the shaders for some of the formats.Textures (PBR): 3 setsTextures resolution: 4096x4096px & 2048x2048.Low Poly Modeling,With Proper UV UnwrappedNo Overlapping.

=========================Available Formats
MAMBFBXOBJUnityPackage* (unity 2017 with textures and materials applied -NO collisions-)
*It can be imported directly in Unity with the textures applied (may need to be scaled for your project).Features
The object has three sets with five textures for Albedo/transparency, Normals, Occlusion, Metallness and Roughness. These can be used in Unity and Unreal engines and other engines capable of displaying PBR textures.Previews are raw untouched Realtime Renders from Unity and Marmoset Toolbag 3, so what you see is what you get.The models have been checked and tested but feel free to contact me if you find problems with the model.
=========================

description_text: This printable M5 Caboose model in N 1:160 scale just needs trucks, couplers, and an etched metal roofwalk such as by Plano or Gold Medal Models. These cabooses were used by Atlantic Coast Line, Seaboard Coast Line, Family Lines, and Seaboard System. The model consists of six STL files: the car body, roof, end railings, chimney, and a jig for bending wire for some grab irons. Also included is a Sketchup file. The Sketchup file is water tight, print ready, and can be edited and rescaled. Note that the scaling in the Sketchup file is ten times larger than the scale size due to Sketchup performing poorly at tiny scales. The N scale body measures 72 mm in length. Includes stl files with resin printer supports for the body and roof (depending on your printer you may need to add supports or configure your own support system). Also included is a variation of the body without rivets in case you'd rather the rivets be modeled as decals. Also included is a scale PDF of the model that can be used for making decals, such as if you want to make a full side decal based on a photo edited to fit exactly right.

description_text:
*Hyperloop *

  - Faces:207131

  - Verts:212020

The Hyperloop is a conceptual high-speed transportation system originally put forward by entrepreneur Elon Musk, incorporating reduced-pressure tubes in which pressurized capsules ride on an air cushion driven by linear induction motors and air compressors.
The outline of the original Hyperloop concept was made public by the release of a preliminary design document in August 2013, which included a notional route running from the Los Angeles region to the San Francisco Bay Area, paralleling the Interstate 5 corridor for most of its length. Preliminary analysis indicated that such a route might obtain an expected journey time of 35 minutes, meaning that passengers would traverse the 350-mile (560 km) route at an average speed of around 600 mph (970 km/h), with a top speed of 760 mph (1,200 km/h). Preliminary cost estimates for the LASF notional route were included in the white paperUS$6 billion for a passenger-only version, and US$7.5 billion for a somewhat larger-diameter version transporting passengers and vehicles although transportation analysts doubted that the system could be constructed on that budget.
Hyperloop technology has been explicitly open-sourced by Musk and , and others have been encouraged to take the ideas and further develop them. To that end, several companies have been formed, and tens of interdisciplinary student-led teams are working to advance the technology.
Designs for test tracks and capsules are currently being developed, with construction of a full-scale prototype 5-mile (8 km)-track scheduled to start in 2016.In addition, a subscale pod design competition on a very short, 1 mile (2 km), test track is underway, with test runs expected later in 2016.

description_text:
This is a modular kitbash set of 3d elements based off the Chicago city or Chicago loop railroad or city metro commuter train. The metro railway in the inner city, as well as areas downtown iconically, is elevated above ground level. This kit captures the iconic structural design of the Chicago rail track in kit form.
This kit is modular and from a 3d as well as a texture point of view, was designed with scaleability in mind. I will enable you to quickly put together large detailed scenes for commercial and personal work, freelance, rendering or animation.It includes the following components:
A switchback with railway curve doing a slight s-bend sectionAn eighth bend - 11.25 degree slight rail track bend sectionA quater bend - 22.5 degree slight rail track bend sectionA half bend - 45 degree slight rail track bend sectionA direction change or track swop sectiona bridge plain sectiona bridge beamed or braced section - alternate the different types for detailA cross beam - add where it makes senseLadder access platforms, add where you want detailtrack stop go lights
Scale:Real world, Metric
File formats:Blender 5 / Cycles - NativeFBX ExportOBJDAETechnical Detail:faces:4,306192Tris:8,618487Verts:5,103384
UVW Unwrapped:Mixed
Textures:4096x4096 - PNGTextures are tileable for higher detail, with ambient occlusion textures supplied to blend in corner, valley or cavity details
Materials:15 different materials, however, some share the same textures but blended with a unique AO or ambient Occlusion texture
Pivots:At object bases, snapped to front left corner of units

description_text:
This 3D Modeling is for 3D printing as a miniature.
The old Seoul Station (literally meaning old Seoul Station building), also known as Culture Station Seoul 284, originally named Gyeongseong station and designed by Tsukamoto Yasushi of Tokyo Imperial University, was finished in November 1925. This red brick building, designed in an eclectic style, features a Byzantine-style central dome and a centralized and symmetrical layout.On September 25, 1981, the old station was designated as Historic Site 284. A restoration project of the old station began in September 2007 to transform the former Seoul Station, which had lost its functionality as a train station since the opening of the new KTX station, into a premier national multidisciplinary cultural facility. On August 9, 2011, the station was reopened as a culture complex with its original exterior, after a two-year restoration project by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the state-run Korea Craft and Design Foundation (KCDF). On April 2, 2012, Culture Seoul Station 284 was officially launched "as a space for diverse artistic and cultural creation and exchange.   (from WIKIPEDIA)

The Citroen 23R represents a typical French Army truck in service at the beginning of World War II.The Citroen 23R was a civilian design light-truck with little modification apart from front towing hooks and a simplified front bumper. The Citroen 23R displayed has additional German Army modifications.A vehicle night-marching device, designated “Notek” by the German army, has been added to the front leftfender in typical German fashion. The Notek light allowed the driver to illuminate the roadway up to25-meters width and 40-meters length in front of the vehicle during night marches without being seen byenemy aircraft. This device became a mandatory piece of equipment early in the war to counter the ever-increasing presence of Allied air power, particularly after 1943. All German transport and armoredvehicles were required to have them. The Citroen 23Rs as well as the larger weight class French army truckscontinued in service with the German army after the invasion and occupation of 1940. Out of the total ofapproximately 6,000 Citroen 23R 1-1/2-ton trucks built, 3,700 were manufactured after 1940.

description_text:
From Wikipedia:The Sd.Kfz. 251 (Sonderkraftfahrzeug 251) half-track was a WW2 German armored fighting vehicle designed by the Hanomag company, based on its earlier, unarmored Sd.Kfz. 11 vehicle. The Sd.Kfz. 251 was designed to transport the panzergrenadiers (German mechanized infantry) into battle. Sd.Kfz. 251s were the most widely produced German half-tracks of the war, with at least 15,252 vehicles and variants produced by seven manufacturers. Some sources state that the Sd.Kfz. 251 was commonly referred to simply as Hanomags by both German and Allied soldiers after the manufacturer of the vehicle. However, that commonly accepted term has come into question -- perhaps only being a postwar label. German officers referred to them as SPW (Schützenpanzerwagen, or armored infantry vehicle) in their daily orders and memoirs.

description_text:
These holders are designed to allow for easy mounting and adjustablility of ALP Parking Sensors.
NOTE:  To assemble the final product you will need additional items:
The holes are in the print file but have to be finished out to a little over 5mm to allow for slip fit of the lock pins and I've found that a 13/64" reamer works best for the job. A drill will also work but the reamer is nicer to work with.  You can do this by hand but it's much easier with any power drill.....just don't poke your eye out!
You will also need a M6 X 1.0 tap to tap the holes for the set screws.  You don't need to tap them all the way through the hole, just deep enough that you can tighten the lockpin assembly with the set screw.
Finally, you will need M6X1.0X10mm set screws.  I highly reccomend 300 series stainless steel, or food grade stainless as they will not rust.

description_text:
These holders are designed to allow for easy mounting and adjustablility of TMG Laser Sensors. Video Shows ALP sensor holders but these are nearly the same, being about 7mm longer from front to back and a few mm narrower on the top.
NOTE: To assemble the final product you will need additional items:
The holes are in the print file but have to be finished out to a little over 5mm to allow for slip fit of the lock pins and I've found that a 13/64" reamer works best for the job. A drill will also work but the reamer is nicer to work with. You can do this by hand but it's much easier with any power drill.....just don't poke your eye out!
You will also need a M6 X 1.0 tap to tap the holes for the set screws. You don't need to tap them all the way through the hole, just deep enough that you can tighten the lockpin assembly with the set screw.
Finally, you will need M6X1.0X10mm set screws. I highly reccomend 300 series stainless steel, or food grade stainless as they will not rust. You will need 2 if using two lock pins per holder or 1 if only using one lock pin.

High-quality low-poly PBR 3D model of Garbage Truck. The interior part ot the cabin is also modeled and textured but with much less detail.
This object is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with all required PBR textures.

PBR texture sets are very detailed, so it makes this model good enough for a close-up.

  - 7 PBR textures sets (License_Plates, Main_Body, Tank, Windows, Perforated, Interior, Wheels)

  - There is also collapsed version of the object (one mesh).

  - Interior part of cabin is modeled and textured with less details.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit optional animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

PBR texture sets details:

  - 2048 Plates PBR texture set (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion)

  - 1024 Interior PBR texture set  (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion).

  - 2048 Wheels PBR texture set  (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion).

description_text:
A boat engine, also known as a marine engine, is a type of internal combustion engine that is specifically designed to power boats and other watercraft. Boat engines come in a variety of types and sizes, ranging from small outboard motors to large inboard engines.
Outboard motors are typically mounted on the transom of the boat and are used for smaller boats and watercraft, such as dinghies and fishing boats. They are portable, easy to install, and provide good maneuverability. Inboard engines, on the other hand, are mounted inside the boat and are used for larger boats, such as yachts and commercial vessels. They are more powerful than outboard motors and provide better fuel efficiency and speed.
Boat engines can be powered by gasoline or diesel fuel, and can be two-stroke or four-stroke engines. Two-stroke engines are simpler and lighter, but tend to be less fuel efficient and emit more pollutants than four-stroke engines. Four-stroke engines are more complex and heavier, but are more fuel efficient and emit fewer pollutants.
Proper maintenance and care of boat engines is important to ensure their longevity and reliability. This includes regular oil changes, filter replacements, and inspections of the engine's components and systems. Overall, boat engines are an essential component of any watercraft and play a crucial role in its performance and safety.

description_text:
A marine diesel engine is a type of internal combustion engine specifically designed for use in marine environments, powering various types of watercraft such as ships, boats, and yachts. These engines are known for their reliability, efficiency, and robust construction, making them a popular choice for marine propulsion.
Marine diesel engines operate on the principle of compression ignition, where fuel is injected into the combustion chamber and ignited by the heat generated during compression. This combustion process produces the necessary power to drive the engine and propel the vessel through the water. Compared to gasoline engines, marine diesel engines offer several advantages, including higher fuel efficiency, longer service life, and better torque at low speeds.
One of the key features of marine diesel engines is their ability to withstand the harsh marine environment. They are designed to operate reliably even under demanding conditions such as high humidity, saltwater exposure, and constant vibrations. The components of marine diesel engines are made from corrosion-resistant materials such as stainless steel and aluminum alloys to ensure longevity and durability.
Marine diesel engines are available in various configurations to meet different power requirements. They range from small engines used in recreational boats to large engines that power commercial vessels and even naval ships. The power output of a marine diesel engine is typically measured in horsepower or kilowatts, and the engines can be single-cylinder or multi-cylinder, depending on the size and application.
Proper maintenance and regular servicing are essential to ensure the optimal performance and longevity of marine diesel engines. This includes regular oil changes, fuel system maintenance, and inspection of engine components for wear and tear. It is usually fast, maneuverable, and equipped with advanced navigation and communication systems. These boats are often used by coast guards, maritime police, and other law enforcement agencies to enforce maritime laws, prevent smuggling, combat piracy, and ensure coastal security.

It may include adjustable support cradles or bunks that conform to the shape of the boat's hull, ensuring a stable and secure fit during transportation. The trailer may also have winches or hydraulic systems to assist in launching and retrieving the patrol boat from the water.
Having a patrol boat with a trailer offers several advantages. Firstly, it provides mobility, allowing law enforcement agencies to cover a larger operational area and respond promptly to incidents or emergencies. Secondly, it enables the boat to be easily transported between different waterways, enabling interagency cooperation and regional collaboration in maritime security efforts.
Furthermore, the trailer allows for convenient storage of the patrol boat when not in use, protecting it from environmental elements and ensuring its longevity. It also facilitates maintenance and repair operations, as the boat can be easily transported to a dedicated facility or workshop for servicing.
In conclusion, a patrol boat with a trailer is a valuable asset for law enforcement agencies involved in maritime security and surveillance. description_text:
A fishing vessel is a specialized maritime vessel designed and equipped for the purpose of catching fish and other marine species. These vessels play a crucial role in the fishing industry, enabling fishermen to venture into the vast oceans and harvest the bounties of the sea. In this description, we will explore the key features and functions of a fishing vessel.
Paragraph 1:A fishing vessel is typically characterized by its sturdy construction and specialized equipment tailored for fishing activities. These vessels come in various sizes and designs, ranging from small, agile boats to large, industrial trawlers. The choice of vessel depends on the type of fishing and the target species.
Paragraph 2:One of the most prominent features of a fishing vessel is its fishing gear. Depending on the fishing method and target species, the vessel may be equipped with nets, lines, traps, or fishing pots. These gears are carefully selected and deployed to optimize the catch and minimize environmental impact, adhering to sustainable fishing practices.
Paragraph 3:To facilitate efficient fishing operations, fishing vessels often have specialized storage facilities. These can include refrigerated holds or tanks to preserve the catch's freshness and quality. Additionally, processing areas may be available on board for cleaning, sorting, and packaging the fish, ensuring they are ready for market.
Paragraph 4:Navigational and safety equipment are vital components of a fishing vessel. These include radar systems, GPS navigation, sonar technology, and radio communication devices. Such equipment helps the crew navigate the open seas, locate fishing grounds, and ensure their safety during adverse weather conditions.
Paragraph 5:Fishing vessels are typically crewed by skilled fishermen who possess extensive knowledge and experience in their trade. The crew members are adept at handling fishing gear, navigating the vessel, and performing necessary maintenance tasks. Their expertise is crucial in maximizing the vessel's efficiency and ensuring a successful fishing operation.
Paragraph 6:In recent years, there has been a growing emphasis on sustainability in the fishing industry. Many fishing vessels now incorporate environmentally friendly practices, such as reducing bycatch, using selective fishing gears, and complying with fishing regulations and quotas. These measures aim to protect marine ecosystems and ensure the long-term viability of fish stocks.
Conclusion:Fishing vessels are the lifeblood of the fishing industry, enabling fishermen to explore the vast oceans and harvest the treasures beneath the waves. With their specialized equipment, storage facilities, navigational tools, and skilled crew members, these vessels are equipped to undertake the demanding task of catching and processing fish. As sustainability continues to be a priority, fishing vessels play a vital role in promoting responsible fishing practices and safeguarding the marine environment for future generations.

Realistic Materials - Substance Painter Tutorial[1hr 46min] Project Files Included
This a step-by-step tutorial showing how to use Substance Painter for all your texturing and material needs.  You will learn everything you need to know from Importing models to Exporting final Texture Maps.  By the end of the lesson you will know how to Bake Maps, Work with Multiple Texture Sets, Use Generators, Create Emissive Maps, Use Smart Masks, Add Materials to specific Color IDs and more.

Files: All files need Substance Painter 2019.2.3 or newer to open
This is part of the Creating Advanced Hard Surface Vehicles in Maya Series: The series is designed to show the workflow from Modeling to Rendering and Lighting but any part can be viewed as a stand alone lesson. Other Lessons that will continue on what you learned here will included Modeling, UV Mapping, Creating Color IDs, and Rendering and Lighting.  You will be provided the proper starting files to follow along.

description_text:
Hello chooms!
This is our cyberpunk 2077 Arch motorcycle!
This motorcycle is heavily inspired by the ARCH Nazaré motorcycle from cyberpunk 2077. It’s one of the most iconic cyberpunk motorcycles.
UE5 version is available will all the materials already setup. As you can see in the video, You can change the color of the bike to whatever you want.
It has 5 set of textures. Each for a specific part of the bike. Each set is in 4k so as you can see in our test renders it has a good quality.
In order to get a nice lighting effect on the front and back lights you need to use the latest version of blender, as it has the Emission strength parameter in principled BSDF.

All Texture sets contain:

  - Base color map

  - Metallic map

  - Roughness map

  - Normal map

  - Height map

  -  Ambient Occlusion map

  -  emission and opacity if necessary

Please keep in mind that this package only includes the bike and its textures, not the lighting and environment. Although if you need that, we can help you after your purchase.

description_text:
ENGLISH:
The Pink Panther Show is a showcase of animated shorts produced by David H. DePatie and Friz Freleng between 1969 and 1978, starring the animated Pink Panther character from the opening credits of the live-action films. The series was produced by Mirisch Films and DePatie–Freleng Enterprises, and was broadcast Saturday mornings on two American television networks: from September 6, 1969, to September 2, 1978, on NBC; and from September 9, 1978, to September 1, 1979, on ABC.
When The Pink Panther Show first aired in 1969, it consisted of one cartoon featuring The Inspector, sandwiched by two Pink Panther entries. Due to the number of shorts produced, two episodes feature a Pink Panther cartoon sandwiched by two Inspector entries. The 30-minute show was then connected via bumper sequences featuring both the panther and Inspector together, with announcer Marvin Miller acting as an off-camera narrator talking to the panther. Bumper sequences consisted of newly animated segments as well as recycled footage from existing cartoons We Give Pink Stamps, Reel Pink, Pink Outs and Super Pink, fitted with new incidental music and voice-over work from Miller.
Pink Panther shorts that were produced after 1969 (starting with A Fly in the Pink) were made for both broadcast and theatrical release, typically appearing on television first, and released to theaters by United Artists. A number of new series were created, including the very popular The Ant and the Aardvark, Tijuana Toads (a.k.a. Texas Toads), Hoot Kloot, Misterjaw, Roland and Rattfink, The Dogfather and two Tijuana Toads spinoffs: The Blue Racer and Crazylegs Crane. The New Pink Panther Show and later shows featured newly animated bumper segments involving the Panther, the Ant and the Aardvark, Misterjaw, and the Texas Toads.
By this time, due to the violent nature of some of the cartoons, they were re-edited for television by omitting the cartoon violent scenes from their broadcasts, in order to make them more family friendly.
In 1976, the half-hour series was revamped into a 90-minute format, as It's the All New Pink Panther Laugh-and-a-Half Hour-and-a-Half Show Introducing Misterjaw; this version included a live-action segment, where comedian Lenny Schultz would read letters and jokes from viewers. This version performed poorly and eventually reverted to the original 30-minute version in 1977 as Think Pink Panther.
After nine years on NBC, the Pink Panther moved to ABC in 1978 and was retitled The All New Pink Panther Show, where it lasted one season before leaving the network realm entirely. The tenth season featured 16 episodes with 32 new Pink Panther cartoons, and 16 featuring Crazylegs Crane: no bumpers were produced for The All New Pink Panther Show, but 10 second Stay tuned... bumpers explaining an upcoming entry were produced for the first several episodes. The 32 All New Pink Panther Show entries were eventually released to theaters by United Artists.
By the time of the show's 1969 debut, fitting cartoon and children's shows with a laugh track was standard practice. In keeping with this standard, NBC added a laugh track to all seasons of The Pink Panther Show, marking the first time in history that theatrical films were fitted with a laugh track for television broadcast (Season 2 utilized an inferior laugh track, utilizing isolated laugh clips from Season 1).This was an anomaly, as other theatrical cartoon series that were aired successfully on television (i.e. Tom and Jerry, Woody Woodpecker, Looney Tunes, Popeye) did not receive this addition.
SPANISH:
The Pink Panther Show es una muestra de cortos animados producidos por David H. DePatie y Friz Freleng entre 1969 y 1978, protagonizados por el personaje animado de Pink Panther de los créditos iniciales de las películas de acción real. La serie fue producida por Mirisch Films y DePatie – Freleng Enterprises y se transmitió los sábados por la mañana en dos cadenas de televisión estadounidenses: del 6 de septiembre de 1969 al 2 de septiembre de 1978, en NBC; y del 9 de septiembre de 1978 al 1 de septiembre de 1979, en ABC.
Cuando The Pink Panther Show se emitió por primera vez en 1969, consistía en una caricatura que presentaba a The Inspector, intercalada por dos entradas de Pink Panther. Debido a la cantidad de cortometrajes producidos, dos episodios presentan una caricatura de la Pantera Rosa intercalada por dos entradas del Inspector. Luego, el programa de 30 minutos se conectó a través de secuencias cortas que mostraban a la pantera y al inspector juntos, con el locutor Marvin Miller actuando como narrador fuera de cámara hablando con la pantera. Las secuencias de parachoques consistieron en segmentos recién animados, así como imágenes recicladas de dibujos animados existentes We Give Pink Stamps, Reel Pink, Pink Outs y Super Pink, equipadas con nueva música incidental y trabajo de voz en off de Miller.
Los cortos de Pink Panther que se produjeron después de 1969 (comenzando con A Fly in the Pink) se realizaron tanto para transmisión como para estreno en cines, por lo general aparecen primero en televisión y son lanzados en cines por United Artists. Se crearon varias series nuevas, incluidas las muy populares The Ant and the Aardvark, Tijuana Toads (también conocido como Texas Toads), Hoot Kloot, Misterjaw, Roland y Rattfink, The Dogfather y dos spin-offs de Tijuana Toads: The Blue Racer y Crazylegs Crane. El New Pink Panther Show y programas posteriores presentaron segmentos parachoques recientemente animados que involucraban a Panther, Ant and the Aardvark, Misterjaw y Texas Toads.
En ese momento, debido a la naturaleza violenta de algunas de las caricaturas, fueron reeditadas para televisión omitiendo las escenas violentas de las caricaturas en sus transmisiones, para hacerlas más familiares.
En 1976, la serie de media hora se renovó a un formato de 90 minutos, como Es el nuevo espectáculo de risa y media hora y media de Pink Panther que presenta a Misterjaw; Esta versión incluía un segmento de acción en vivo, donde el comediante Lenny Schultz leía cartas y chistes de los espectadores. Esta versión funcionó mal y finalmente volvió a la versión original de 30 minutos en 1977 como Think Pink Panther.
Después de nueve años en NBC, Pink Panther se mudó a ABC en 1978 y pasó a llamarse The All New Pink Panther Show, donde duró una temporada antes de abandonar la cadena por completo. La décima temporada contó con 16 episodios con 32 nuevos dibujos animados de Pink Panther y 16 con Crazylegs Crane: no se produjeron parachoques para The All New Pink Panther Show, pero se produjeron parachoques de 10 segundos Estén atentos ... que explican una próxima entrada para el primeros episodios. Las 32 entradas del All New Pink Panther Show finalmente fueron lanzadas en los cines por United Artists.
En el momento del debut del programa en 1969, adaptar programas infantiles y de dibujos animados con una pista de risas era una práctica estándar. De acuerdo con este estándar, NBC agregó una pista de risa a todas las temporadas de The Pink Panther Show, marcando la primera vez en la historia que las películas teatrales fueron equipadas con una pista de risa para transmisión televisiva (la temporada 2 utilizó una pista de risa inferior, utilizando risas aisladas). clips de la temporada 1).Esto fue una anomalía, ya que otras series de dibujos animados teatrales que se transmitieron con éxito por televisión (es decir, Tom y Jerry, Woody Woodpecker, Looney Tunes, Popeye) no recibieron esta adición.

description_text: A floating restaurant is a vessel, usually a large steel barge or hulk, used as a restaurant on water. The Jumbo Kingdom at Aberdeen in Hong Kong is an example. Sometimes retired ships are given a second lease on life as floating restaurants. The former car ferry New York, built in 1941, serves as DiMillo's in Portland, Maine. Another example is the train ferry Lansdowne, which served as a restaurant in Detroit. Plans for Lansdowne to continue in this capacity on the Buffalo, New York waterfront came to naught and she was scrapped in the summer of 2008. A third example of a ship's hull converted for this purpose is Captain John's Harbour Boat Restaurant in Toronto, which was located on MS Jadran, a former Yugoslavian ship but has since been closed and scrapped. Normac, the first Captain John's restaurant, was moved to Port Dahousie as the floating cocktail lounge Big Kahuna and is now the Riverboat Mexican Grill.

description_text:
This is 1:9 scale model kit of WWII army truck. The model is optimized for FDM 3D printing, it is composed of more than 120 parts, but it remains very easy to assemble, something to delight young and old alike, prepare your 3D printer!
Detailed assembly picture guide is included. Always double check printed parts if they fit together before gluing them. Around 900 grams of filamentis required to print the whole model. 180x180mm or bigger print bed is required.
Model is created using nurbs modelling to achieve high precision and surface smoothness.
3D PRINTING SETTINGSEvery part can be printed with 0.4mm nozzle. Layer height varies between 0.1 and 0.25mm - depends on what quality you want to achieve. Always try to hide and align z-seams (retractions) on outer perimeters to achvieve nice and clean surfaces.
Model includes fitting tolerances and has been printed and assembled with several different printers. If parts don't fit well, double check your printer calibration please. Perfectly calibrated X, Y, Z dimensions, extruder and good quality filament are a must have. I recommend calibrating X and X with 100mm (or bigger) square, Z with at least 10mm height. Even a little overextrusion or first layer's elephant foot can cause problems fitting parts together. I recommend 0.4mm nozzle and 0.15-0.2 layer height for big parts, 0.3mm nozzle and 0.1mm layer height for small parts.

description_text:
General Description

  - Detailed 3d model of a Spinning Stationary Bike.

  - The native aplication is Blender version 2.92 (FBX and OBJ formats are included).

  - The model is made on a real scale (You can see the proportion with a person in one of the sample images).

  - The Blender file comes with all textures packed, all paths are relative and all objects have the transformations applied (Origin at point 0, 0, 0).

  - You will find a PDF with instructions so that the use of the model is easy for you.

  - Just open your Blender file, press F12 to render and you will get the main sample image (you will find a collection with a ready lighting setup).

Geometry

  - The model has 151.625 vertices (at the zero level of Subdivision). 

  - It is modeled only with quads and a correct topology to work with Subdivisons.

Textures / UVs

  - The model is composed of two material with 6 PBR textures in PNG format of 4k resolution.

  -  In order to get the maximum texture resolution, the model has some parts like screws, adjusters (parts that are repeated in general) with overlapping UVs.

  - Objects that have overlapping UVs have a group of vertices called Overlapping UVs which contains the overlapping UVs.

Highly detailed and optimized geometry suitable for close-up shots.
Photorealistic textures focusing on glossy paint, rugged plastics, and metal finishes.
Modeled to accurate real-world scale and proportions.
Perfect for both studio render setups and rugged outdoor environment scenes.
Important Note for Buyers:
All 3D model formats (OBJ, FBX, STL, BLEND, etc.) along with all high-resolution texture files are carefully packed into one main ZIP folder. Simply download, extract, and drop it directly into your scene!

description_text:
Cartoon Bicycle – Stylized Low-Poly 3D ModelThis Cartoon Bicycle 3D Model is a carefully crafted, production-ready asset designed for a wide range of 3D applications, including animation, game development, educational content, visualization, and 3D printing. Created in Blender 3.5.1 and rendered with the Cycles engine, the model combines a playful, vibrant appearance with optimized, clean geometry for excellent performance in both real-time and offline rendering workflows.
With its exaggerated proportions, bold color palette, and simplified form, this bicycle fits perfectly into cartoon, fantasy, or stylized environments. Each part of the model is neatly organized and named, making it easy to customize materials, swap colors, and modify components without breaking the topology or UV layout.
Model Features
  - 
Playful Stylized Design – The model features rounded shapes, thick elements, and charming proportions, creating a warm and friendly look ideal for stylized projects.

  - 
Optimized Low-Poly Geometry – 182,761 vertices and 182,085 polygons provide a balance between detail and performance, ensuring smooth usage in games, animations, and VR/AR projects.

  - 
Separated Components for Flexibility – The frame, wheels, tires, pedals, and seat are separated into distinct objects, enabling easy modifications, animations, and replacements.

  - 
Procedural Materials in Blender – Includes fully procedural shaders for flexible customization, allowing you to quickly change the look without UV re-baking.

  - 
UV Unwrapped & Organized – Clean UV maps are provided for accurate texture placement, baking, or painting, with non-overlapping UV islands for professional workflows.

  - 
3D Print Ready – Clean mesh with no non-manifold geometry, watertight structure, and minimal overhangs make it suitable for 3D printing without extensive pre-processing.

  - 
Multiple File Formats – Available in .blend, .fbx, .obj, and .stl, ensuring compatibility with all major 3D software and game engines.

Technical Details
  - 
Software Used: Blender 3.5.1

  - 
Renderer: Cycles

  - 
Vertices: 182,761

  - 
Polygons: 182,085

  - 
Topology: Clean quad-based mesh with minimal triangles

  -

  -

Ideal Use Cases
  - 
Game Development – Works perfectly as a stylized prop in casual, adventure, or low-poly games. Can be used as a background object, collectible item, or interactive element.

  - 
Animated Films & Commercials – Fits well in animated films, TV ads, children’s educational content, and explainer videos with a stylized, approachable feel.

  - 
Product Design & Visualization – Great for toy design concepts, children’s bicycles, and themed product presentations.

  - 
3D Printing Projects – Ideal for creating physical models, toys, or prototypes due to its print-ready geometry.

  - 
Educational & Tutorial Content – Perfect for beginners learning about stylized asset creation, UV mapping, and clean topology.

Why Choose This Model?Created using industry-standard 3D modeling best practices. Fully optimized for Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity, and other platforms. Versatile usage – from games and animation to product visualization and physical prints. Professional UV mapping for high-quality texturing. Ready for customization – change colors, materials, and proportions without breaking the mesh.
Included File Formats:.blend | .fbx | .obj | .stl
The Cartoon Bicycle – Stylized Low-Poly 3D Model offers an excellent combination of style, usability, and flexibility. Whether you’re creating a vibrant animated scene, designing a fun game environment, or producing 3D printed toys, this model provides the perfect starting point. Its clean geometry, organized layout, and compatibility across multiple platforms make it an asset you can easily integrate into your project with minimal adjustments.

description_text:
This 3D model of a science-fiction engine is inspired by modern rocket engines and is designed for use in 3D rendering (not intended for 3D printing). With an industrial design, the engine would be well-suited for use in spaceships, vehicles, or laboratory testing environments. It is primarily composed of quad geometry, and all modifiers have been applied to the available format files. The native formats include two engine variants: one with 1 level of subdivision (totaling 283,340 faces) and another with 2 levels of subdivision, suitable for close-up renders (totaling 770,218 faces).
When downloading, I recommend using the file named reactor engine.zip since it contains the formats and textures organized into individual folders, ensuring that files with missing textures are not an issue. In case you encounter missing textures, there is a folder named textures.zip where you will find two textures for each of the two different subdivision models (the engines consist of two objects: the main parts and the auxiliary parts). The texture folders for the 1 subdivision level engine are labeled lower poly model. The texture maps used for this model include color, roughness, ambient occlusion, metallic, normal, and displacement in PNG format.
While most formats come preconfigured for the textures, if you wish to change the materials, you can do so in the second native file named SCI-FI engine.blend as it utilizes procedural textures.
Please note that the thumbnail is purely illustrative of the model, and the scene contains only the engines as shown in the rest of the preview images. There are no cables, engine stands, or exhaust animations included.

description_text:
Assorted gear collection, accurately modeled and ready for use in CAD and 3D print applications. Modeled in Autodesk Inventor and provided in multiple file formats (IPT/IAM, STP, SAT, IGS, and STL). Gears are constructed with modular geometry, allowing them to be combined in an endless variety of ways. Easily create complex power transmission systems that produce rotational motion, speed multipliers, and torque multipliers. Perfect for both digital and physical mechanical design projects.
Native Autodesk Inventor 2012 files are provided with intact browser trees and parameter tables to allow full configurability and customization.
Collection includes 15 models:

  - Spur gear, 8-tooth, round bore (0.50in pitch diameter, 12.7mm reference diameter)

  - Spur gear, 8-tooth, D-profile bore (0.50in pitch diameter, 12.7mm reference diameter)

  - Spur gear, 12-tooth, round bore with keyway (0.75in pitch diameter, 19.05mm reference diameter)

  - Spur gear, 16-tooth, round bore with keyway (1.00in pitch diameter, 25.4mm reference diameter)

  - Spur gear, 24-tooth, round bore with keyway (1.50in pitch diameter, 38.1mm reference diameter)

  - Spur gear, 32-tooth, round bore with keyway (2.00in pitch diameter, 50.8mm reference diameter)

  - Spur gear, 48-tooth, round bore with keyway (3.00in pitch diameter, 76.2mm reference diameter)

  - Spur gear, 64-tooth, round bore with keyway (4.00in pitch diameter, 101.6mm reference diameter)

  - Gear rack, 16-tooth (4.00in (101.6mm) eye-to-eye distance)

  - Ring gear, 32-tooth external, 24-tooth internal (2.00in external pitch diameter, 50.8mm external reference diameter)

  - Ring gear, 48-tooth external, 32-tooth internal (3.00in external pitch diameter, 76.2mm external reference diameter)

  - Ring gear, 64-tooth external, 48-tooth internal (4.00in external pitch diameter, 101.6mm external reference diameter)

  - Bevel gear, 16-tooth, round bore with keyway (1.00in pitch diameter, 25.4mm reference diameter)

  - Helical worm, D-profile bore (0.50in pitch diameter, 12.7mm reference diameter)

  - Spacer, round bore (0.25in (6.35mm) face width)

All gear tooth profiles are precisely modeled with accurate arc-based geometry and a small amount of backlash to ensure proper engagement. Gears can be used as drive gears (rotationally locked to shaft) or idle gears (free spinning about shaft).
All gears are provided with a diametrical pitch of 16 teeth/inch (module 1.6). All gear bores are designed for a 0.25in (6.35mm) nominal shaft size. Gears can be easily scaled to create any diametrical pitch or module that you may need.
The centerline distance between any two mating gears is ( First Gear Pitch Diameter + Second Gear Pitch Diameter ) / 2.
All models are provided in 5 file formats:

  - IPT/IAM (Autodesk Inventor 2012 format for CAD)

  - STP (general solid model format for CAD)

  - SAT (general solid model format for CAD)

  - IGS (general solid model format for CAD)

  - STL (general surface model format for 3D print)

Product also includes a Read Me text file (TXT format) detailing the physical dimensions of all gears.
If you have any questions, either before or after purchasing this model collection, please feel free to contact me here on CGTrader and I will help in any way possible.

Product is ready to render out of the box (3DS Max only).

A Standard material is used to contain both JPG texture, bump and specular maps with 2040 x 2040 resolution.
USAGE:
This model is suitable for use in games, virtual reality, augmented reality, broadcast, design visualization, forensic presentation, technical demonstrations, etc.

description_text:
Futuristic Sci Fi Gear Lever.
Seperated objects (every part), sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.Made in Cinema 4D then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR
Formats included:C4D (R20), FBX, OBJ, DAE, 3DS ; Tex: png with Alpha
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048 4096x4096 PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for rendering engines or game engines!

description_text:
Low-floor Škoda ForCity Smart tram for city of Helsinki (FIN)Bogies of particular tram are designed to rotate freely and withstand constant changes of Helsinki’ urban landscape.Particular tram was designed to suit needs of Helsinki light railway needs. Turns are numerous, sharp and steep.
3D model is combined of modular carriages (sections), head section and tail car.Bump maps, weathering effects, reflections, multiple imperfections are distributed around the model to bring authenticity and blur computational touch, to make it look realistic.PBR materials, Worked out Topology, non-overlapping UVW
Vehicle is 27m long, 2.5m wide. It has 4 trolleys and uses 1000mm rail gaugeEquipment and complex parts - bogies, pantograph, gangways - are developed according to real model dimensions.High quality photography and open technical data was taken in consideration.
Outer shell of model is designed, following industrial design principles - tram body is assembled of panels with physical seams.This approach enhances perception of model, makes it look less linear and plain.Physically created spacings produce shadows, help to trace visual borders between elements.Finally, this allows to build some hierarchy among many parts and catch observer’s eye.
4096x Texture Set: AO, Diffuse, Metallic, Roughness, Normal, 3dsMax+Corona Renderer

description_text:
3D model garbage truck that can be used for video games and 3d animation with a simple design. This is a fairly simple model, excluding the interior (only the steering and seat scheme).
A garbage truck is a truck specially designed to collect municipal solid waste and transport it to a solid waste treatment facility, such as a landfill, recycling center or transfer station. In Australia they are commonly called rubbish trucks, or garbage trucks, while in the U.K. dustbin lorry or bin lorry is commonly used. Other common names for this type of truck include trash truck in the United States, and refuse truck, dustcart, junk truck, bin wagon or bin van elsewhere. Technical names include waste collection vehicle and refuse collection vehicle (RCV). These trucks are a common sight in most urban areas.

description_text: Drones, also known as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), come in various types, each designed for specific purposes and applications. The first type is the recreational or consumer drone, which is popular among hobbyists and enthusiasts for aerial photography, videography, and recreational flying. These drones are usually compact, lightweight, and equipped with cameras for capturing stunning aerial footage. The second type is the commercial drone, widely used in industries such as agriculture, construction, and surveying. These drones often have advanced sensors and imaging capabilities to assist in data collection and analysis. The third type is the military drone, employed for surveillance, reconnaissance, and combat missions. Military drones can be armed with weapons or used for intelligence gathering in challenging environments. Finally, there are specialized drones like delivery drones or industrial inspection drones, designed to carry out specific tasks such as delivering packages or inspecting infrastructure. These drones often have unique features tailored to their specific applications. With advancements in technology, drones continue to evolve, expanding their capabilities and finding new applications across various sectors.

A Drone Command Center represents the nerve center of unmanned aerial operations, playing a pivotal role in coordinating and overseeing drone missions across various domains. These high-tech facilities are equipped with state-of-the-art technology, including advanced monitoring systems, communication hubs, and powerful data processing units. Drone operators and mission planners work collaboratively within these centers, remotely piloting drones, monitoring their flight paths, and collecting real-time data from the drones' onboard sensors. The command center's personnel are responsible for not only ensuring the safety and compliance of drone operations but also for making critical decisions based on the information gathered. Whether it's for military reconnaissance, search and rescue missions, or industrial applications, the Drone Command Center serves as a crucial hub for effective, efficient, and secure drone operations.
In addition to mission control, Drone Command Centers also foster innovation in drone technology and applications. They serve as hubs for research and development, where experts can fine-tune drone capabilities and explore new use cases. These centers often collaborate with government agencies, private enterprises, and academic institutions to push the boundaries of drone technology, leading to breakthroughs in fields such as agriculture, environmental monitoring, and disaster response. The ongoing advancements in drone technology, coupled with the expertise and coordination provided by these command centers, are contributing to a safer, more efficient, and technologically advanced world, where drones are becoming increasingly integral to various aspects of our lives.

These centers often collaborate with government agencies, private enterprises, and academic institutions to push the boundaries of drone technology, leading to breakthroughs in fields such as agriculture, environmental monitoring, and disaster response. description_text: A floating restaurant is a vessel, usually a large steel barge or hulk, used as a restaurant on water. The Jumbo Kingdom at Aberdeen in Hong Kong is an example. Sometimes retired ships are given a second lease on life as floating restaurants. The former car ferry New York, built in 1941, serves as DiMillo's in Portland, Maine. Another example is the train ferry Lansdowne, which served as a restaurant in Detroit. Plans for Lansdowne to continue in this capacity on the Buffalo, New York waterfront came to naught and she was scrapped in the summer of 2008. A third example of a ship's hull converted for this purpose is Captain John's Harbour Boat Restaurant in Toronto, which was located on MS Jadran, a former Yugoslavian ship but has since been closed and scrapped. Normac, the first Captain John's restaurant, was moved to Port Dahousie as the floating cocktail lounge Big Kahuna and is now the Riverboat Mexican Grill.
